findings.finding: An effective automatic resale shelf (F-3ASR, 2026-09-28) lets three Li Shufu-controlled holders sell 58.6M Class A ADSs, about 36% of the class, on any session including 2026-10-14, into a market that trades about $1.7m a day.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The registration is effective on filing and names the selling holders, so sales can occur on 2026-10-14 with no further filing first; it is standing supply rather than a dated event, which is why it is sized small.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock closed at $6.93 on 2026-09-25, before the filing, and is $4.275 at the screen (-38%), with no sale ever disclosed under the shelf; the 2026-09-08 13D/A Item 5(c) reports no transactions in the prior 60 days and Item 4 discloses no plan to sell.
findings.why_not_priced: The overhang is two weeks old and the stock has fallen through it, so most of the fear is priced; what is not priced is an actual sale, which would show up only in a 13D/A within two business days and has not appeared. If the market fully held a sale, the stock would be trading as if a block were coming, not drifting on 1.6x volume.
findings.independence: Kalkine reported the same registration as a resale by three major holders: https://kalkinemedia.com/us/news/announcements/polestar-files-sec-registration-for-resale-of-586m-ads-by-three-major-shareholders
